text: Smoked Beets. I started by peeling the beets (being very careful not to stain things) so I could get the seasoning deep into the root vegetable. The seasoning was applied with olive oil & consisted of kosher salt, #10 & #16 mesh black pepper, raw sugar, garlic powder, season salt, adobo powder, chipotle powder, celery seed, sumac, & arbol powder. I smoked the beets on my Weber Smoky Mountain smoker at 300F on the lower rack with the water pan removed using a mix of lump charcoal & mesquite wood for around 2 hours until they reached 205-210F internal temperature. After the beets were cooked I wrapped them in foil with a garlic/thyme compound butter then placed them in my toaster oven set to 150F until everything else was done cooking. I served these beets alongside asparagus & pork loin with a wine sauce. This was my first time roasting beets & I’ll definitely do it again. It’s way more similar in taste to a potato than I expected (almost 1:1) so the only thing I’d really advise other first timers is: more butter & more salt than you might think. If you’ve never tried smoked or grilled beets this might be one to add to your repertoire.
